summary: Harris County lookout tower on the Georgia list (GFC 305); a 1955 Columbus Ledger item names two tower operators, Harris Tower and William Mountain Tower; no source describes it now.

facts.status_note: No source we checked says whether the tower still stands

events.note: October 29, 1955 item names Henry M. Koone at Harris Tower and Idus T. Averett at William Mountain Tower as the unit's tower operators; the item gives no location for either tower

evidence.supports: list row: Harris County Lookout Tower at 32.77180, -84.90521 in Harris County, coded GA023, GFC number 305
list page map revision stamp dated March 22, 2016
item attributed to The Columbus Ledger
Harris County has an organized forestry unit tied to the Georgia Forestry Commission, as do many other Georgia counties
evidence.quote: forestry units affiliated with the Georgia Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: county lookout operator described as watching over more than 147,000 acres that make up the county's total woodland
evidence.quote: The Harris County lookout tower operator serves as the sentinel of the forests over 147,000 acres

evidence.supports: two named tower operators, Harris Tower and William Mountain Tower
evidence.quote: The tower operators for the Harris County Forestry Unit are Henry M. Koone who mans Harris Tower and Idus T. Averett who is stationed in William Mountain Tower.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out against the list (Harris County, GFC 305); no corrections. Staffing is documented only for 1955, from a newspaper item reprinted on Forest Lookouts. The item names Harris Tower and William Mountain Tower but gives no location, so the story does not say the state-list tower (GA023) is Harris Tower. Possible name matches on the same list, unconfirmed: GA202 williams mtn (Harris, GFC 307, 32.71249,-85.06855) and GA196 pine mtn (Harris, 32.77367,-84.90277). The 1955 item says the forestry units are affiliated with the Georgia Forestry Commission; no source names the owner of this tower, so agency is not in facts. Searches found no current status.
